text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text:
...You want to haul the prototype in? Be
my guest. So long as you do
it yourselves, I
won't stop you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. There's one more thing... I'm
sorry to ask this, but would
you mind if we
borrowed your vehicle to do it?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! So how far did your plane fly?
Did it get up into the
clouds? Were they
fluffy?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
T-Turbo, you're bombarding the poor man
with questions!

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Heh... So you want to go for a ride in the
plane?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I wanna make one too! I wonder how
amazing the new plane will
be! I can't wait
to find out!

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Look at that...
You have that sparkle
in your eye. You remind
me of my
apprentice, when I first met her.

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Though lately...
she looks like she's sinking
under the weight of her
burdens.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Does that mean you're keeping an eye
on her, even now?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Then you should talk to her! You'd make
her day! I'm sure it'd
motivate her to keep
going with her research!

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text:
...That's the reason I can't talk to her.
Nothing good'll come of
sticking my nose
in where it doesn't belong.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I get it... You thought you'd be a burden
to her, so you stepped back
from working
together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text:
...I have no intention of adding to her
troubles. But, somewhere in my
heart, I'm
praying for her.

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text:
She believes wholeheartedly in her dream,
so I pray that she can
make it come true.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You're putting your hopes in her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're right—having great expectations
put on your shoulders can be
tough.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And that pressure can hold you back...
So I
kinda get why you don't
want to talk to
your old student.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
'Cause sometimes, it feels like the moment
you fail to meet those
expectations, you'll
get crushed under their weight...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But... even then...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No matter how heavy they get, I'm happy to have them, because it means people are counting on me. I want them to count on me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Having someone cheering me on motivates
me to do whatever it takes
to make them
proud!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't change the burden, but it's
because those expectations are heavy that
I've gained the strength to bear them
without getting
crushed!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Prez waited patiently for me, knowing that
I would succeed.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What about you? Do you believe in your
student? Or do you think
she's so weak
that she'll buckle under the pressure?

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text:
...Don't be daft. Once I gave her a task,
she kept at it until it was
done perfectly.
She's got more grit than anybody I know.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Yeah. Plus, she's got super-talented
geniuses like us to help
her!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! I'm going full turbo to help
too! So you don't have to
worry—we've got
her back!

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Heh... If you say so.
Well, you need my
truck, right? Then follow me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
This is... considerably rustier than I was
expecting! Can it even move?

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Probably. If we can get it running, then I
think we're in business. It'll
need a boost,
though.

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text:
The "how" is pretty straightforward. We
help it along by giving it a
push. The tricky
part is making sure we focus on driving
our force in the same direction.

text_block_list.name: Former Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Meaning it won't be easy with a bunch of
people. One person will have to do the
pushing... but the truck's pretty heavy. I
don't know if
any of you can move it.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I'll do it! I wanna do it! All I've gotta do is push, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If there's even the slightest chance we
can
get the truck moving, then
we'll take it!
Hit it with your turbo boost, Double Jet!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: That's Twin Turbo! You got the "turbo boost" part right, so why'd you mess up my name?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Here goes! Hrraaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ngggggh!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... huff... Dangit, this is tough! But I'm gonna fly that plane no matter what! I'll never give up!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo boooost!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Rrraaaaagh! Moooove!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Her outfit changed?! Ohh! This is the "EX
Job Change" thing in
action!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the skill that can only be activated
once! And she's changed jobs
to...
Steamrunner!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hngh! Nrrrrrrgh! Graaaaah! Urraagh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
She's got a jetpack and it's still not
enough?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: It... is... enough! Hrrrrgh! I will get this truck moving!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'll get the truck moving!
I'm gonna fly that
plane! I just gotta push
harder! Mooooove!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm not giving up! I won't lose! Never!
Kyahahaha, bring it ooooon!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hgh! Ngggrrraaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clank! Vooooom!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: It moved!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Gooooo! Moooove!
